[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mods simply adds some of Cornucopia's herbs, as well as the Lavender flower as a functional seasoning to cooking via the Custom Seasoning framework. Available in German and English. German has slightly odd formatting but it was either that or a wrong grammar in half the dishes.[/color][/size]
 
 
 
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55650/55650-1794873625-1746331784.png[/img][/center]
[center] [/center]
[center] [/center]
To install it, either let your favourite mod manager do the work for you, or simply put it into your ./Mods folder.
To remove it [sad noises] delete it from your ./Mods folder, or let the mod manager do it for you.
 
 
 
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55650/55650-1794873662-289775106.png[/img][/center]
Mandatory:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55633]Custom Seasoning[/url]

You need at least one of these for the mod to have any effect:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]
